utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the third of August. Can you all hear me, or am I doing the silent stand-up again?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, got you. I was just saying, my weekend plans were entirely dependent on that promised sunshine. Ended up watching rain from a caravan.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: That's a proper British holiday, that. Paid extra for the view of the rain?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Pretty much. Forecast for next weekend looks lovely, so obviously I don't believe a word of it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Quite. And apparently the charity bake sale on Friday is already causing arguments about what counts as homemade.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: The charity bake sale on Friday is the only reason I've got cash in my wallet. Shop-bought cake on your own plate still counts, surely.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Not with the price sticker underneath, mate.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes a cake audit. What's finished, and then what actually needs an owner?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah so, tested the water system yesterday and it's all fine now. That's finished, nothing new coming out of that.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Good. Nice to have one that's just closed.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Also, already swapped the filter on the Injection Moulding Line 1 yesterday. That job's done as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Separately, we still need someone to swap the filter on the line 1 hydraulics next Tuesday. It's urgent. Don't lose that against the completed filter entry.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Um, I'm not putting my hand up for that one. I haven't got the capacity to commit to it.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Me neither, sorry. No offer from me on that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, nobody's taken it. The line 1 hydraulics filter stays unowned, urgent, next Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And just for the history, I signed off the inspection on the feedwater pump on Tuesday. Last Tuesday, that was. Already signed off, not another inspection for today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks. Callum Reid, can you update the risk assessment for work on the Boiler Feedwater Pump? Separate from that completed inspection.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll update the risk assessment for work on the Boiler Feedwater Pump. That's mine.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Exactly, the inspection sign-off doesn't mean that risk assessment's been updated.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, two different things. That's clear.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: While we're doing observations, noticed the IM3 was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down. Just an observation, I'm not raising a job off it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, settled down. Not another red box on the board, then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Still waiting on parts for the pick and place on two, nothing we can do until they arrive. That's the parts-dependent work still blocked.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah. The guarding check is separate from doing the work that needs those parts, though.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: It is. Tomasz, can you check the guarding on the pick and place on two? Drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Understood. I'll check the guarding on the pick and place on two. That takes precedence.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you—so that's a check, not saying the blocked repair can go ahead?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. The parts blocker hasn't gone away. We're agreeing the guarding check, nothing beyond that.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And I'll schedule downtime for the GT2 with production by Wednesday. No rush on that one; it sits behind the guarding.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Cheers, Tom. Scheduling with production by Wednesday, got it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, just to be clear, by Wednesday is for scheduling it. I'm not saying the downtime itself is Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Hannah Price, can you take vibration readings on the gas turbine two on Friday, if you've got a spare minute?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take vibration readings on the gas turbine two on Friday, if I've got a spare minute.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Right, that's the spare-minute one, not another drop-everything job?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Exactly. On Friday, as agreed, but it's the spare-minute priority.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Um, on the other hydraulic job, still waiting on parts for the IM1 hydraulic unit, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. I'll replace the seals on the IM1 hydraulic unit at half two. That's my agreed job, but it is still blocked by those parts.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Right, Saz, at half two, but only possible if the parts have arrived. I'm not confirming a delivery there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Absolutely. Mine at half two, with that blocker showing. I'm not pretending we can replace seals we haven't got.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Fine. An agreed time isn't a promise from the supplier. Understood.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And we were going to replace the belt on the main water valve but that's been pushed to next month, so ignore it. Cancelled from this lot, not a job for today.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep. That old entry was making the list look longer than it is.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I'll do the pre-use checks on the FLTs next Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Han. That one's safety critical, straight away. For next Tuesday, those checks come before use.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Agreed. Next Tuesday, I'll do the pre-use checks on the FLTs straight away, before they're used. Safety critical.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: So we're keeping next Tuesday, not accidentally dragging that date into today because we've said straight away?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yes, next Tuesday. Straight away for the pre-use checks then, not a different date.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Han, can you also grease and check the bearings on the water booster tomorrow morning? Low priority, that one.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll grease and check the bearings on the water booster tomorrow morning. Low priority, understood.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And that's separate maintenance from my water system test yesterday. Test's still done.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. We're not reopening your completed test.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'll recalibrate the sensors on the air dryer by Thursday. That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Okay, Sarah Okafor against the air dryer sensor recalibration, by Thursday. That's you owning it, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, me. I'll start straight away because it's safety critical, with the recalibration done by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: There's quite a spread there. Safety critical, drop everything, and then genuinely low priority. Easy to hear them all as urgent on a crackly call.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, don't flatten the priorities. They're different for a reason.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Speaking of crackly, is that someone's mic rubbing, or am I hearing a crisp packet?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Headset cable. Bit early even for my breakfast crisps.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Before we finish: swap the filter on the line 1 hydraulics, next Tuesday, it's urgent. Still nobody on it; we haven't magically allocated it by talking about it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And don't put me down from the yesterday update. The Injection Moulding Line 1 filter swap I mentioned was completed work.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. The outstanding one remains unallocated.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I've got my three clear: water booster tomorrow morning, gas turbine two on Friday if I've got a spare minute, and FLTs next Tuesday, safety critical before use.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Same here. Guarding first, drop everything. GT2 downtime scheduling by Wednesday, no rush on that.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And the parts blockers are still blockers. Nothing said on this call means they've arrived.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Agreed. Right, that's us. Thanks, everyone.
